cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID. The World Bank counted nearly 4 million enrolled, 49% of the population, in March 2026, against the government's more than 6 million numbers at the end of 2025; ANID's September 2026 count of more than six million is the newest.
cells.note: More than 6 million with a NIU at the end of 2025 and in September 2026 are about 70% of the population. Nothing counts 99.9%.
